<a2ui>
surface("status-list")

filterHeading = heading("Filter by status")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Active", value: "active"}, {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}, {label: "Blocked", value: "blocked"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}], "all", "status_filter")

listHeading = heading("Items (8)")
list = entity_list([
  {name: "Design system audit", subtitle: "Review component usage across all product surfaces", icon: "🎨", status: "Active", meta: "Due Fri"},
  {name: "Payment API migration", subtitle: "Waiting on vendor credentials before cutover", icon: "💳", status: "Blocked", meta: "Due Mar 3"},
  {name: "Onboarding copy refresh", subtitle: "Draft of new welcome emails ready for review", icon: "✉️", status: "Pending", meta: "Due Mar 6"},
  {name: "Accessibility fixes", subtitle: "All critical contrast issues resolved and verified", icon: "♿", status: "Done", meta: "Closed Feb 20"},
  {name: "Search relevance tuning", subtitle: "Testing new ranking weights on 10% of traffic", icon: "🔎", status: "Active", meta: "Due Mar 10"},
  {name: "Q2 roadmap planning", subtitle: "Needs stakeholder sign-off on priorities", icon: "🗺️", status: "Pending", meta: "Due Mar 12"},
  {name: "Data retention policy", subtitle: "Legal review is holding up the final draft", icon: "🗄️", status: "Blocked", meta: "Due Mar 15"},
  {name: "Mobile release 4.2", subtitle: "Shipped to both app stores without incidents", icon: "📱", status: "Done", meta: "Closed Feb 28"}
])

root = columns(2, "1.5rem", "top", [{blocks: [filterHeading, filter]}, {blocks: [listHeading, list]}])
</a2ui>

The status filter is a segmented control beside the list of eight items. The catalog's list and filter components are static and can't be wired to each other, so choosing a status won't hide rows. Making it filter would need a data-bound list.
